note: LA.18b. A handler path with a template segment (`@ServerEndpoint("/chat/{room}")`) pairs a concrete client path segment-for-segment; a parameter matches exactly ONE segment, so /chat/lobby/feed does not pair. Baseline 2026-09-18 (HEAD 7a4883b): no Java WS needle, so no handler; ws_pair compares segments literally.
